info.title: Forward Geocoding API - Convert Address to Lat/Long Coordinates
info.description: Convert a free-form address, place name, or point of interest into geographic coordinates. Returns up to 40 ranked matches per request, each with latitude/longitude, a structured address breakdown (street, city, state, country), a WGS84 bounding box, and any points of interest at that location. Use the `limit` parameter to control result count, the four `min_lat`/`max_lat`/`min_lon`/`max_lon` parameters together to bias results toward a geographic viewbox, and the `Accept-Language` header to localize result names. A query that matches nothing returns a `404` error rather than an empty array.

get.summary: Convert an address or place name into geographic coordinates
get.description: Search for a free-form address, place name, or point of interest and return matching locations with coordinates, structured address components, and a bounding box.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-form search query, e.g. `Wembley Stadium, London`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. May return fewer if matches are weak.

parameters.name: min_lat
parameters.description: Minimum latitude of the viewbox used to bias results. Must be provided together with `max_lat`, `min_lon`, and `max_lon`, and must be less than or equal to `max_lat`.

parameters.name: max_lat
parameters.description: Maximum latitude of the viewbox used to bias results. Must be provided together with `min_lat`, `min_lon`, and `max_lon`, and must be greater than or equal to `min_lat`.

parameters.name: min_lon
parameters.description: Minimum longitude of the viewbox used to bias results. Must be provided together with `min_lat`, `max_lat`, and `max_lon`, and must be less than or equal to `max_lon`.

parameters.name: max_lon
parameters.description: Maximum longitude of the viewbox used to bias results. Must be provided together with `min_lat`, `max_lat`, and `min_lon`, and must be greater than or equal to `min_lon`.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Preferred language order for result names, as a comma-separated list of language codes or a single code. Results are returned in the first matched language, falling back to `en` if none match.

value.name: Wembley Stadium
value.full_address: Wembley Stadium, Pacific Crescent, London Borough of Brent, Greater London, England, HA9 0SL, United Kingdom

400.description: Bad Request — Invalid or missing parameters

value.message: Please provide a valid limit. Valid range is from 1 to 40.
Minimum latitude cannot be greater than maximum latitude in the viewbox.
Minimum longitude cannot be greater than maximum longitude in the viewbox.

404.description: Not Found — No results matched the query

value.message: No results found for the given query.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

ForwardGeocodeResponse.title: Forward Geocoding Results
ForwardGeocodeResponse.description: List of locations matching the search query, one entry per match, up to the number requested via `limit`.

GeocodeResponse.description: A single geocoded location with coordinates and structured address components.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude value for the location.

lon.description: WGS84 longitude value for the location.

name.description: Name for the primary place searched.

category.description: High-level category of the place, e.g. amenity, place, natural, building, highway.

type.description: Specific kind within the category, e.g. fast_food, city, park, residential, house_number.

poi.description: Points of interest at this location.

area.description: Intra-city area below city level, e.g. suburb, borough, ward, district, tehsil, neighbourhood.

city.description: Settlement label appropriate to the country, e.g. city, town, municipality.

county.description: Second-tier administrative area, e.g. county, district, prefecture.

state_code.description: Subdivision code, typically ISO-3166-2 (e.g. US-TX, PK-PB).

state.description: First-tier administrative area, e.g. state, region, province, division.

country_code.description: Two-letter country code in upper case, ISO-3166-1 alpha-2.

country.description: Country name of the searched place.

full_address.description: Single-line, human-readable address of the location.

bounding_box.description: Extent of the feature as `[lat_min, lat_max, lon_min, lon_max]` in WGS84 decimal degrees.

PointOfInterest.description: A point of interest located at or near a geocoded result.

name.description: Name of the point of interest.

category.description: High-level category of the point of interest, e.g. amenity, place, natural, building, highway.

type.description: Specific kind within the category, e.g. fast_food, city, park, residential, house_number.
